about_s1_body: StumbUpon.com is a web discovery tool. Click a button and land on a site you'd never have searched for — filtered by your interests, voted on by the community. It's the antidote to infinite scroll: one site at a time, carefully curated.
about_scroll_p1: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok — these platforms have turned browsing into something passive: you scroll, you absorb, you drift. They optimise for time spent, not for the quality of the experience. Notifications, reward loops, gamification — everything is designed to capture attention, not to enrich it.
about_scroll_p2: StumbUpon.com takes the opposite stance: one site at a time. No feed, no notifications, no score, no streak. You open the site when you decide to, stay as long as you want, leave when you want. This is discovery, not consumption.
about_why_p1: StumbleUpon shut down in 2018 after 16 years. It was magical: one click and you'd land on a site you'd never have searched for. Passionate blogs, interactive web experiments, fascinating archives — the web in all its diversity.
about_why_p2: Its downfall is telling. In chasing monetisation, they introduced 'sponsored stumbles'. Quality dropped, trust followed. Social media competition did the rest. When they closed, no real equivalent took over.
about_why_p3: This project is my answer. No investors, no advertising pressure, no growth targets. Just the desire to recreate that magic — signposts towards an open, curious, living web.
about_s2_step1: Choose your interests when you sign up — art, science, programming, music… 25 themes available.
about_s2_step2: Click Stumble — the algorithm picks a site from the catalogue based on your tastes and community votes.
about_s2_step3: Vote 👍 or 👎 — your votes refine future discoveries and save your favourites automatically.
about_s2_step4: Tune your tastes from the "My tastes" page to give more or less weight to each theme.
about_p1_body: Every site is manually reviewed before entering the catalogue. We'd rather have 500 remarkable sites than 500,000 average ones.
about_p2_body: No advertising, no Google Analytics, no third-party cookies. A self-hosted visit counter — that's it.
about_p3_body: We're a signpost, not a destination. We champion small independent sites, personal pages, and quirky projects — everything the big platform algorithms bury.
about_p4_body: You can always see why a site was recommended to you, and take back control of your preferences. No black box.
about_s4_body: Know a remarkable site worth discovering? Submit it — it will be reviewed and, if it fits our criteria, added to the catalogue.
about_s5_body: StumbUpon.com is a personal open-source project, built by Dany and self-hosted in Belgium. No investors, no growth targets — just a love of the open web.
